text: Hassan and I used to climb the poplar trees
wave us down from the tree
Go on, now
I stepped into Hassan and Ali’s quarters
I went past the rosebushes to Baba’s mansion
Hassan to the mud shack
She ran off with a clan of traveling singers and dancers
we were walking from my father’s house to Cinema Zainab
taking the shortcut through the military barracks near Istiqlal Middle School
We hopped the fence
skipped over a little creek
broke into the open dirt field
Ali was taking me to the bazaar
I was walking behind him
He just kept walking
sneaked it into bed with me that night
driven them from their lands
she was gone
when all six-foot-five of him thundered into the room
Baba took me to Ghargha Lake
They would leave
he lowered himself into the leather sofa
a thief walked into my grandfather’s house
he turned out to be a wanderer from the Kunduz region
flew to Tehran
Baba took me to the yearly Buzkashi tournament
carry that carcass with him around the stadium
other chapandaz chases him
riders pounded past us
I cried all the way back home
shuffling around the house
when they come home
